BrochureContent.Content:
Beverly Court is a small private development surrounded by mature gardens in a truly special location tucked away just off Vernon Avenue within a few minutes walk of St Anne's Park and enjoys an enviable setting with every amenity you could wish for just moments away—from scenic park and coastal walks and cycling paths, to cafés, restaurants, and excellent transport links via DART and bus.

No 6 is a dual aspect ground floor apartment extending to c. 650 square feet. The layout is both practical and spacious, comprising a generous living room with a fireplace, a functional kitchen/dining room, two bright bedrooms, a bathroom, and a hallway with storage. Large windows invite in natural light and offer pleasant green views, enhancing the warm and peaceful atmosphere throughout.

Whilst dated with a little fresh thinking this lovely apartment will suit those looking to downsize, first-time buyers seeking a prime location, or investors looking for a consistently high-demand rental. With its well-kept communal grounds, secure setting, and unmatched location, No 6 offers the perfect blend of privacy and connectivity.

For further information or to arrange a viewing, contact Gallagher Quigley Estate Agents today.
